test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs.5704 in 3 years and to Rs.6072 in 4 years. The sum is:
solution:
**Given:-**

Amount in 3rd year = Rs. 5704

Amount in 4th year = Rs. 6072

Time difference = 1 year

**Formula used:-**

Amount = Principal + S.I.

**Calculation:-**

S.I. in 1 year = 6072 - 5704 = Rs. 368

S.I. in 3 year = 3 × 368 = Rs. 1104

⇒ Amount = Principal + S.I. 

⇒ 5704 = Principal + 1104

⇒ Principal = 5704 - 1104 = Rs. 4600

**∴ The sum (principal) is Rs.__ 4600__.**
